platform: Bass Rebels LabelRadar and Streamable-Link Demo Submission Route
manual_review_reason: Bass Rebels directs demos primarily to LabelRadar and provides an authorized fallback email link when LabelRadar is unavailable. The first-party LabelRadar link resolved as a broken relative path during passive verification, and the fallback address was not exposed in plaintext. A human must open the current official page, use only the displayed route, inspect any LabelRadar account, credit, terms or runtime-verification boundary, prepare a streamable SoundCloud or Dropbox link, verify track rights and metadata, and submit or send manually.

platform: DI.FM Electronic Radio Channel Discovery Route
manual_review_reason: DI.FM accepts brief new-music and demo requests by email to multiple Channel Directors. Requests need a channel-matching genre and description, may contain media links, and must not contain attachments. The Send Request destination is Cloudflare-protected and was not decoded. A human must select the channel, prepare a concise rights-cleared request, distinguish a demo from a regular-show proposal and send manually.
